title: Physical interpretation: the chirality channel as confining background
html:
Remark. Physical interpretation: the chirality channel as confining background

Remark (Physical interpretation). The chirality component contributes a positive, attractive confining force across all isotopes. It actively counterbalances the net-negative repulsive base structure, framing the gauge-invariant background holding mass conglomerates together.
